content:
Hi folks-- I had proposed small change to wasi-http which picked up a couple +1s. What's the right way to get it formally approved / merged / etc?

(For those who don't want to click through: the change is explicitly allowing changing the case in field names for transmission. HPACK has a built-in table that uses lowercase names; requiring case preservation could prohibit making use of this compression in some cases.)
You need a wasi-http proposal champion to land it, which is effectively just Luke
